newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy truck deliveries fall five pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Italy truck deliveries fall five pct in April.

text.p: Italian commercial vehicle deliveries in April slipped 5.14 percent to 12,632 vehicles compared to April 1996, the Italian automakers' association Anfia and importing body Unrae said in a statement.
In the first four months of this year, deliveries totalled 48,294, a fall of 8.8 percent over the same period last year.
Italian domestic manufacturers saw April deliveries fall by 9.47 percent to 7,170 vehicles, giving them a market share of 56.76 percent against 59.48 percent a year ago.

Among the domestic makers, Fiat Auto saw deliveries fall 9.26 percent to 4,907 while Fiat heavy truck unit Iveco registered a drop of 18.24 percent to 1,515. But light van maker Piaggio deliveries were up 12.26 percent to 696 vehicles.
Among importers, Ford saw deliveries fall 21 percent to 1,310 while Nissan was down 11.5 percent with 768, but Mercedes showed a gain of 32.65 percent with 650 vehicles.
Renault deliveries fell 6.86 percent to 638 and Volkswagen was off 8.42 percent at 544. But Peugeot deliveries in April jumped 143.2 percent to 270.
